title: Toddler Sleep Regression
description: A little one has started waking up every few hours, and tomorrow still expects everyone to function.
wisdom: Small children do not keep adult calendars. The goal is not a perfect night; it is a plan that keeps everyone safe, supported, and a little less frayed.

choices.label: Trade night shifts
choices.memory: You and your partner traded night shifts through the toddler sleep regression.

choices.label: Handle it solo
choices.memory: You handled the wakeups alone and paid for it the next day.

choices.label: Ask family for backup
choices.memory: You asked trusted family for backup so everyone could recover.

title: Teen Driving Practice
description: A teenager in the family needs supervised driving hours, and the nearest empty parking lot suddenly feels like a final boss arena.
wisdom: Teaching independence is rarely comfortable. Patience now becomes confidence later, especially when the stakes include turn signals and everyone's blood pressure.

choices.label: Practice calmly after dinner
choices.memory: You made time for calm driving practice with the teen.

choices.label: Pay for extra lessons
choices.memory: You paid for extra driving lessons to add structure and confidence.

choices.label: Keep postponing it
choices.memory: You postponed driving practice and the teen noticed the delay.
